mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies and a temperature of 61 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park. We are currently under a Waxing Crescent moon, and if you are up early, you can catch the space station passing from over Mount Horeb toward Fitchburg and Madison, reaching almost directly overhead starting at 5:35 AM.

The Common Council has approved new sewer and stormwater utility rates to ensure our city infrastructure remains self-supporting and well-maintained. Also, the city has officially selected the four student winners for the I Voted sticker contest, whose artwork will be featured at polling locations this November.

There is plenty happening around town today, including the Epic Systems User Group Meeting. Tonight, you can test your knowledge at Hop Haus or Wisconsin Brewing Company trivia. Tomorrow, the downtown farmer's market returns to Hometown Junction Park, along with trivia at The Bogey Factory and pizza night at Lake Lou-ee.
In police news, on August 15, officers responded to a situation involving a reckless driver who was ultimately arrested for a second offence of O W I.
Today's flavor is the delicious Caramel Chocolate Pecan. Culvers is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor of the day is Double Strawberry.
